meta.title: Start onboarding for a prospect
gaps: Navigate to Vendors > Prospects, select a prospect, start onboarding, choose an onboarding template, confirm the action, and verify the prospect moves to Onboarding in Progress.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Navigate to Vendors > Prospects, select a prospect, start onboarding, choose an onboarding template, confirm the action, and verify the prospect moves to Onboarding in Progress.

args.need: navigate to Vendors > Prospects, select a prospect, click Start Onboarding, choose a template under Onboarding Template, confirm sending the prospect to the onboarding event, and stop when the success state or Onboarding in Progress tab is visible

steps.note: No catalog step can reach or operate the Vendors and Prospects onboarding flow.

args.text: You have successfully started the onboarding for a vendor!

steps.note: Checks the stated success confirmation after the tester completes the onboarding action.
Checks that the prospect is shown in the expected destination tab.
